log: You stand at The Town Gate.
A notice board by the gate has 3 notices pinned to it.
The Tavern has beds for 4 gold a night and a kitchen.
The Wrack came in the night: one great tide over everything you knew. You remember the cold, and the dark, and holding on.
⚑ You wake on a strange shore, the first tide behind you, the land new and the drowned already stirring. You remember all you learned. Deep Lungs: +8 HP.
You make your way to Fish-Smelling Quay.
You return to The Town Gate.
